meta.title: Tick 23 Worker A — FMM Payload Report
meta.description: Controller-ready diagnosis, row dispositions, gold suspects, and verification receipts for the no_rule payload batch.

props.title: FMM no_rule payload batch
props.subtitle: Five FMM payload failures repaired through generic contract and match-boundary mechanisms; content disputes and out-of-scope parser/splitter defects were left fail-closed.

props.content:
**Empty-parameter report request.** Scenario compilation is correct: the source turn compiles to `report_request {}`. Dispatch then selects `report_request.say_intentions` and rewrites the proposal before matching to `pilot_intentions_report_obligation {report_event: intentions, condition: immediate}`. The matcher therefore never sees a `report_request` command, so its documented intent-only empty-rule behavior is never exercised. This is a source-gold versus contract-content dispute, not phase filtering, scenario canonicalization, or an empty-rule matcher bug.

**IFR route clearance.** Gold and runtime carry the same route content but differ in case, punctuation, and `vectors` versus `vector`. One shared normalizer now canonicalizes both compiled rules and runtime proposals, with the singular/plural token alias owned by the dispatch contract. Direct-to fix casing uses the same boundary.

props.title: Fail-closed preserved
props.content: The matcher itself was not weakened. Regression tests prove different route content remains unequal and an altitude rule still rejects a proposal that omits altitude.
